root.name: Van Geet Opening: Berlin Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 Nc6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 dxe4 4. d5

overview: After 1.e4 Nc6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 dxe4 4.d5 White gains a tempo on the c6 knight, which usually retreats to e5, and plays for a lead in development with Qd4 or Bf4 while Black is a pawn up. Black tries to consolidate with ...Ng6 or ...Nf6 and ...e6. The name and exact theory are unfamiliar, so this is reasoned from the moves.

white_ideas.idea: Gain a tempo with d5 and follow with Qd4, Bf4 or Bg5 against the displaced knight
Develop quickly and regain the e4 pawn or attack the exposed knight on e5
Use the cramping pawn on d5 to restrict Black

black_ideas.idea: Keep the extra e4 pawn and move the knight to a safe square (...Ne5, ...Ng6)
Break the d5 pawn with ...e6 or ...c6
Trade down White lead in development

typical_structures.structure: White pawn on d5 against a Black pawn on e4 with Black a pawn up, French-like asymmetry

character.notes: Early tempo gains and a pawn down for White make for concrete play with tactics around the knight on e5.

gambit.notes: Black has captured on e4 and can keep the pawn if White does not regain it by force.

soundness.notes: Black can simply hold the pawn; White has no clear compensation.

structure.notes: d5 pawn cramps Black while pieces stay mobile, lines open quickly.

approach.notes: A rare sideline of an uncommon defence, seldom chosen by strong White players.

level.notes: Little theory and fairly clear plans, but it is not a good repertoire choice.

character.reason: White is a pawn down and plays for fast tactics against the knight.

gambit.reason: Black holds the e4 pawn unless White wins it back by development.

soundness.reason: Black can keep the pawn and White has only a short lead in development.

structure.reason: White d5 pawn against Black e-pawn gives a French-like asymmetry with open lines.

approach.reason: Rare line of a rare defence, played for surprise.

level.reason: Few forcing lines to learn, but the position is awkward to play well.

plans.reason: White aims at a lead in development and the d5 spearhead.
